releases.tagline: One-click updates, a snappier start, and a fresh coat of paint.

New: One-click updates are here! TickerScope now gives you a little nudge when a new version lands and installs it for you - no download hunting, no fuss.
Fancy Windows Terminal? The installer can set it up for the sharpest look. Prefer to keep it classic? Skip it - TickerScope won't hold a grudge.
Improvements: Snappier start - the menu pops up almost the moment you launch instead of making you twiddle your thumbs.
A shiny new TickerScope icon strutting its stuff on your app, shortcuts and taskbar.
Fixes:
Spotted a gremlin? You tell me!
Feel free to communicate if you find any bugs or scopes for improvements
